title: Quick Report Wizard - Part II
author: Luis Pineiros, Technical Services Team Member, 4D Inc.
featured_technology: 4D v11 SQL Quick Report Plug-in / Report Plug-in Area
Quick Report (QR) commands (40+ commands, e.g. QR REPORT TO BLOB)

historical_commentary.text: This note documents the programming side of a custom multi-step Quick Report Wizard built on 4D v11 SQL's integrated Report Plug-in and its 40+ QR commands, covering both List and Cross-Tab report types with formatting, styling, borders, and column widths all controlled programmatically. This is a classic-era reporting technique built around the older Quick Report engine and a hand-rolled DIALOG-driven wizard UI, which is squarely in the area 4D has since modernized: 4D Write Pro and 4D View Pro (introduced roughly v16-v18) provide far richer, more maintainable document and spreadsheet-style reporting, and 4D's own Quick Report/Quick Form concept has evolved considerably since v11. The underlying idea of giving end users self-service ad hoc reporting remains valuable, but the specific QR command set and the custom wizard shown here reflect a reporting architecture 4D has since layered over with more powerful alternatives.
related_updates: 4D Write Pro (~v16) and 4D View Pro (~v17-18) now handle richer document/report generation than the classic Quick Report/Report Plug-in Area
4D's Quick Report/Quick Form feature set has evolved substantially since 4D v11 SQL Release 4
